title: Label assigned to each symbol
statement: For natural numbers $cS$ and $F$, define a map from the eight symbols to labels by sending the symbols to their corresponding labels as follows: $\mathrm{nt}\mapsto\mathrm{hT}$, $\mathrm{la1}\mapsto\mathrm{sT0}$, $\mathrm{la2}\mapsto\mathrm{sT1}$, $\mathrm{kR}\mapsto\mathrm{rI}$, $\mathrm{ri}\mapsto\mathrm{rT}$, $\mathrm{kj}\mapsto\mathrm{sT}$, $\mathrm{kc}\mapsto\mathrm{dD}$, and $\mathrm{cc}\mapsto\mathrm{sT}$.
